name: glow_plugs
description: Use when a diesel is hard to start cold, smokes white or idles rough after a cold start, or the glow-plug light flashes.
instructions: Call read_dtcs: glow-plug codes P0380-P0384 (circuit or relay) and P0670-P0684 (per plug or control module) name the plug or the controller.
Open fault_codes and use read_dtcs_detail on each glow-plug code; open module_scan when it is offered for the engine module's own codes.
Call read_live {"pids":["0105","0142"]} once: battery voltage and coolant temperature decide the glow time.
There is no output test in this phase: say a workshop can measure the plugs or run the glow-plug output test.
interpret: One failed plug: a rough start and some white smoke in the first seconds when cold; two or more: hard cold starts.
A glow-plug light that flashes while driving signals a stored engine fault, not only a plug.
A coolant sensor that reads warm on a cold engine shortens the glow time and makes cold starts hard.
A weak battery (under about 11 V while glowing) heats the plugs less: check the battery first.
